description:
At Render, we’re building the modern cloud platform for developers creating AI-native, full-stack, multi-service applications. Our mission is to eliminate the tradeoff between the power of hyperscalers and the simplicity of developer-friendly platforms—so teams can ship fast, scale reliably, and focus on their product, not infrastructure.

Unlike complex hyperscalers or ephemeral edge/serverless solutions, Render offers a developer-first experience with persistent compute, dynamic autoscaling, built-in orchestration, and observability, allowing teams to launch, scale, and manage real-world applications without writing infrastructure code or managing servers. Whether you're building LLM-powered applications, scalable SaaS products, or async processing pipelines, Render empowers teams to move fast and scale confidently from MVP to millions of users.

Our platform is trusted by over 7 million developers worldwide and continues to grow rapidly. In February 2026, we raised an additional $100M in Series C financing, bringing our total funding to $260M, to accelerate our vision of making cloud infrastructure both powerful and intuitive—designed for the speed of modern AI development.

We’re a diverse and talented team that values craft, velocity, and user experience. If you’re excited to help shape the future of the intelligent cloud and empower developers everywhere, we’d love to hear from you.

Applying to Render

We're seeking candidates who possess high integrity, humility, and an insatiable drive to learn. Through reasoned discussions and continuous feedback, we strive to improve both individually and collectively. We foster an environment of mutual trust and respect, empowering effective debate to achieve the best outcomes for our customers and team.

We especially encourage members of underrepresented groups in the tech community to apply and understand that not all successful candidates will meet each requirement listed.

Our interview process is unique to each role, and we value the candidate experience just as much as our customer experience. We hope your conversations with us reflect a thoughtful process that is illuminative, enjoyable, and respectful of your time.

About the Role

Millions of developers already build on Render, and most of them found us on their own. Paid media is one of the main ways we'll reach the next wave.

As our Paid Media Lead, you’ll own self-serve paid acquisition and our brand media program. You’ll also own the paid setup campaigns run on: ad accounts, standards, partners and measurement. That includes performance channels like search, paid social and retargeting, plus developer newsletters, podcasts, paid placements, sponsorships and out-of-home. You'll set the strategy and run the experiments. Demand Gen directs its own pipeline budget through your setup. You provide support for DevRel, Developer Experience, Product Marketing and Partner Marketing campaigns.

This is a role for a senior media strategist who still likes being hands-on. In your first year you'll build and run campaigns yourself, alongside our dedicated performance agency and, for larger brand buys, a specialist . You'll also work with Marketing Ops, who build our agents and GTM tooling to ensure we’re properly tracking and measuring what matters. You'd rather build a function than inherit one.

What You'll Do

  • Own self-serve paid acquisition and our paid strategy. This is the core of the role. Set the channel mix across performance, sponsorships and brand, allocate spend against the objectives we agree each quarter, and move money to what's working. Align with our Lifecycle lead on who we're trying to attract and activate, and optimize toward it. You'll be measured on incremental activated signups and CAC or payback.

  • Run a deliberate experimentation program. Build and run a test roadmap with clear hypotheses, holdouts and incrementality tests. Keep a test log and share results so other teams can use them.

  • Be the execution partner for Demand Gen and other teams. Demand Gen owns the strategy, goals and targeting for its pipeline budget; you make sure its account-based campaigns run well, tying spend to opportunities and revenue. Run one intake process for DevRel, DX, PMM and Partner Marketing, within budgets agreed to each quarter.

  • Run brand media. Plan and run out-of-home, podcast, newsletter and paid influencer programs with our Creative Director and VP of Marketing. Measure what paid brand campaigns add, through lift studies and branded search. Overall brand lift is a shared goal.

  • Own our performance contractor relationship. Set scope, goals and priorities across self-serve, Demand Gen and brand, protect the capacity Demand Gen relies on, hold them to agreed results, and decide what we should run in-house.

  • Own the shared paid setup. Ad accounts, conversion events, UTM standards, audience exclusions and keyword rules for every paid campaign, including Demand Gen's. Work with RevOps, Marketing Ops and Data, who report attribution, and with Developer Experience and our Creative Director on ads and landing pages that work for developers.

  • Automate paid operations with AI. Work with Marketing Ops to automate campaign builds, pacing, reporting, sponsorship tracking and anomaly detection. You decide what to automate and own the results, so your time goes to strategy and execution.

In Your First Six Months

  • Take over self-serve paid acquisition and set baselines and goals for our main channels.

  • Audit and standardize the shared paid setup, and align with Demand Gen’s goals.

  • Take over brand media buys from our VP of Marketing and launch a brand campaign.

  • Publish a test roadmap and share the first results.

  • Get two or three paid operational workflows automated with Marketing Ops.

What We're Looking For

  • 7+ years in paid media, including leading strategy and owning results for [multi-million-dollar] annual budgets across several channels.

  • Deep experience in self-serve or product-led paid acquisition.

  • Experience supporting a sales-led pipeline motion too, including account-based advertising. You know how to measure each funnel.

  • A track record of running experiments, including incrementality and holdout tests, and changing course based on what you learned.

  • Brand media experience as a secondary strength. You've planned or bought sponsorships, newsletters, podcasts or out-of-home, or directed partners who did, and you can measure them honestly.

  • An instinct for developer audiences. You know developers hate being marketed to and you build campaigns that respect that.

  • You're comfortable in ad platforms, analytics tools and spreadsheets, and you build your own reporting.

  • You get teams you don't manage to move with you, and you can say no without damaging the relationship.

  • Experience automating parts of paid operations, such as bidding scripts, automated rules or reporting pipelines, and enthusiasm for working with AI agents.

  • San Francisco or remote in the US

Nice-to-Haves

  • Paid media experience at a developer tools, cloud infrastructure or other technical B2B company.

  • Experience building a paid media function from scratch or consolidating one that was spread across teams.

  • Account-based advertising and offline conversion setup with HubSpot or a similar CRM.

  • Experience with product analytics tools, and an understanding of how conversion data flows from ad platforms into the CRM.

  • Experience managing agencies and specialist partners and deciding what to bring in-house.

  • Hands-on experience building or running AI agent workflows.

If this role excites you but you don’t meet every single requirement, we’d still love to hear from you—your unique experience might be just what we need.

Benefits

  • 4 weeks of paid vacation.

  • 14 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all parents to bond with a newly born, adopted, or fostered child. We will also work with you to create a supportive plan of return.

  • Long-term disability, life insurance, and 401K plans.

  • 100% employer-paid medical coverage and 99% employer-paid dental and vision coverage for you and a dependent. FSAs and HSAs are available as well.

  • Monthly lifestyle stipend for wellness, mental health and therapy, hobbies, etc.

  • Monthly cell phone and internet subsidy.

  • Commuter benefits for Renders in the Bay Area, and home office stipends for remote Renders.

  • Continuous learning benefits & related support.

This position is generally not eligible for new visa sponsorship. At Render's discretion, the business may sponsor existing visa transfers. Applicants who require sponsorship must receive business authorization.

Render is an equal-opportunity employer. We know that employing a team rich in diverse thoughts, experiences, and opinions allows our employees, product, and community to flourish. We make all employment decisions including hiring, evaluation, termination, promotional, and training opportunities, without regard to race, religion, color, sex, age, national origin, ancestry, sexual orientation, physical handicap, mental disability, medical condition, disability, gender or identity or expression, pregnancy or pregnancy-related condition, marital status, height and/or weight.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

We encourage all who are interested to apply. We can't wait to hear from you!
